Method of Attack: VBScript-based RAT distributing via PasteBin; infected computer downloads VBScript from paste sites, connects to C&C server, gains persistence by setting up local folder and registry key
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by VBScript-based RATs
Attack Vector: Distribution of VBScript RAT via PasteBin and other paste sites; use of dynamic DNS subdomains and a registered domain (microsofit.net) for C&C servers
Indicators of Compromise: C&C servers on 105 dynamic DNS subdomains (e.g., mohammadx47.ddns.net, mohamedsaeed.ddns.net)
VBScript files posted on paste sites in spikes during August 2016, October 2016, and March 2017
